# Move blue bar up toward the charcoal/magenta blocks
# Currently at rows 16-19, need to get closer to rows 4-7
# Move up 2 times (8 rows) to reach rows 8-11
result = action(['UP', 'UP'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation

def find_node(seg, color):
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == color:
            rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
            cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols), n['pixels'])
    return None

print("After 2x UP:")
print("Blue bar:", find_node(seg, 'b'))
print("Charcoal:", find_node(seg, 'c'))
print("Magenta:", find_node(seg, 'M'))

# Check adjacency
adj = seg['adjacency_list']
blue_id = None
for i, n in enumerate(seg['nodes']):
    if n['color'] == 'b':
        blue_id = i
        break
print("Blue bar adjacency:", [pair for pair in adj if blue_id in pair])

# Try one more UP to get closer
result = action(['UP'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
print("\nAfter 1 more UP:")
print("Blue bar:", find_node(seg, 'b'))
print("All nodes:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
    print(f"  {n['color']}: rows {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, cols {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}, {n['pixels']}px, children={n['children']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
